# Temporary Commissioning Infrastructure, Power, and Utilities {#sec-temporary-commissioning-utilities}

## Worked Example: 8-Hour 20 MW Level 5 IST Load-Bank Energy & Utility Cost

Running an 8-hour full-load thermal heat test on a $20\text{ MW}$ critical facility requires $160\text{ MWh}$ ($160,000\text{ kWh}$) of electrical energy [@ref19_datacenterscope_cx]:

$$E_{\text{IST}} = P_{\text{critical}} \times t_{\text{test}} = 20\text{ MW} \times 8\text{ h} = 160\text{ MWh}$$ {#eq-ist-energy}

At an industrial utility tariff of $\$0.10/\text{kWh}$, the utility electrical consumption cost for a single 8-hour test run is $\$16,000$, exclusive of load-bank rental, temporary MV/LV cabling, setup labor, and test engineering fees [@ref19_datacenterscope_cx].

```{python}
#| label: tbl-ist-loadbank-calculator
#| tbl-cap: "Interactive Python Calculator: Level 5 IST Electrical Energy and Diesel Fuel Consumption"

def ist_cost_calculator(load_mw=20.0, hours=8.0, tariff_per_kwh=0.10, genset_hours=4.0, l_per_kwh=0.26, diesel_per_l=1.10):
    energy_mwh = load_mw * hours
    utility_usd = energy_mwh * 1000.0 * tariff_per_kwh
    diesel_l = (load_mw * 1000.0 * genset_hours) * l_per_kwh
    diesel_usd = diesel_l * diesel_per_l
    return energy_mwh, utility_usd, diesel_l, diesel_usd

print(f"{'Load (MW)':<10} | {'Duration (h)':<12} | {'Energy (MWh)':<13} | {'Utility Cost ($)':<16} | {'4h Genset Diesel (L)':<20} | {'Diesel Cost ($)'}")
print("-" * 94)
for mw, hrs in [(10.0, 8.0), (20.0, 8.0), (20.0, 24.0), (40.0, 24.0)]:
    e_mwh, u_usd, d_l, d_usd = ist_cost_calculator(mw, hrs)
    print(f"{mw:<10.1f} | {hrs:<12.1f} | {e_mwh:<13.1f} | ${u_usd:<15,.2f} | {d_l:<20,.1f} | ${d_usd:,.2f}")
```
